speaker: 내레이션
text: Once upon a time, in a small village, there lived a kind old man named Geppetto.

speaker: 내레이션
text: But sometimes, his little house felt very quiet.

speaker: 제페토
text: Look at you, little wooden boy!

speaker: 제페토
text: You have two arms, two legs, and a funny little nose.

speaker: 내레이션
text: That night, a beautiful blue light floated through the window.

speaker: 파란 요정
text: You made this little boy with so much love.

speaker: 파란 요정
text: Let me give him a little magic.

speaker: 파란 요정
text: Remember to be kind and tell the truth.

speaker: 파란 요정
text: Yes. The truth is very important.

speaker: 내레이션
text: The little wooden boy had so much to learn.

speaker: 내레이션
text: And his adventure was just beginning.
